content.text: Use eval to fetch all pages. Check link href format.

input.command: orca eval --expression '(async()=>{const hrefs=[...document.querySelectorAll("a")].map(a=>a.href);const out=[];for(let p=1;p<=10;p++){const u=new URL(hrefs.find(h=>/2/.test(h))||location.href);const link=[...document.querySelectorAll("a")].find(a=>a.textContent.trim()==String(p));const url=link?link.href:location.href;const html=await (await fetch(url)).text();const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(html,"text/html");const info=d.querySelector("main p")?.textContent;d.querySelectorAll("tbody tr, table tr").forEach(r=>{const c=[...r.querySelectorAll("td")].map(x=>x.textContent.trim());if(c.length)out.push([p,info,...c].join("|"))});}return JSON.stringify({hrefs,rows:out})})()' --json
